criterion_details.name: Technical Capability
criterion_details.evidence: modular monolith-to-microservices path on Azure AKS, .NET 8 services, Azure SQL, Service Bus.
criterion_details.justification: The technical architecture is robust and scalable, designed for 8,000 concurrent users, indicating a strong technical capability.

criterion_details.name: Implementation Plan
criterion_details.evidence: 18-week plan with the clearest work breakdown: 5 phases, 32 milestones, resource-loaded Gantt, and 10% schedule contingency.
criterion_details.justification: The implementation plan is exceptionally detailed with clear milestones and a comprehensive risk plan, demonstrating thorough planning.

criterion_details.name: Commercial Value
criterion_details.evidence: Pricing clarity is excellent: fixed-fee with unit rates for changes ($175/hr), no hidden uplift.
criterion_details.justification: The commercial value is transparent with detailed assumptions and a clear pricing structure, though a slight deduction is due to the total cost being on the higher side.

criterion_details.name: Security & Compliance
criterion_details.evidence: Certifications: ISO 27001:2022 certified, SOC 2 Type II.
criterion_details.justification: Strong security and compliance measures are in place, including relevant certifications and GDPR/CCPA compliance, indicating a high level of security.

criterion_details.name: Support & Experience
criterion_details.evidence: Support model that has earned 4.8/5 CSAT across 20 projects.
criterion_details.justification: The support model is robust with high customer satisfaction and extensive experience in similar projects, indicating strong capability in support and experience.

risks: Medium findings from pen test that need remediation
suppliers.overall_summary: NexaWorks presents a strong proposal with a well-defined implementation plan and robust technical capabilities. Their high customer satisfaction and comprehensive security measures further enhance their offering, making them a competitive candidate.
